_source: design/08 §2.3 — the committed public-surface golden. `node tools/api-snapshot.mjs` rewrites it; `--check` is the gate. `values` is Object.keys() of the built entry; `types` is the entry .d.ts read through the TypeScript 5.9.3 compiler API. `_arity` is each type's declared type-parameter count and exists only so the types@<5.9 stub can mirror it.
